pages.quiz:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is "st" pronounced at the start of "Stuhl"? (1 mark)
   A. like sht
   B. like st in stone
   C. like sd
   D. like sk

2. What does "Danke" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hello (friendly)
   B. good morning
   C. goodbye
   D. thank you

3. Which little word goes with the noun "Tochter"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

4. Which little word goes with the noun "Schwester"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. die
   D. den

5. What does "Es hat vier Zimmer" mean? (1 mark)
   A. It has four doors
   B. It has four rooms
   C. It has four beds
   D. It has four gardens

6. Which little word goes with the noun "Bett"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. der
   D. die

7. What does "Noch einmal!" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Well done!
   B. Thank you!
   C. One more time!
   D. Goodbye!

8. Which mark comes before a list or a quotation? (1 mark)
   A. der Doppelpunkt (:)
   B. der Punkt (.)
   C. das Fragezeichen (?)
   D. das Komma (,)

9. Which German word is the number 10? (1 mark)
   A. acht
   B. vier
   C. dreizehn
   D. zehn

10. Which month comes right after "September"? (1 mark)
   A. Juni
   B. Mai
   C. Oktober
   D. August

11. Which little word goes with the noun "Mittagessen"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

12. What does "die Tomate" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. breakfast
   B. fish
   C. tomato
   D. banana

13. What does "der Kakao" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cocoa
   B. watermelon
   C. mango
   D. cheese

14. What does "die Mango" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. mango
   B. water
   C. potato
   D. cabbage or kale

15. What does "braune Augen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. brown shoes
   B. black hair
   C. blue sky
   D. brown eyes

16. What does "das Gesicht" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. head
   B. leg
   C. back
   D. face

17. What does "die Wolke" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cloud
   B. weather
   C. wind
   D. thunderstorm

18. What does "Regenzeit" mean? (1 mark)
   A. dry season
   B. rainy season
   C. rainbow
   D. thunder

19. What does "helfen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to learn or study
   B. to help
   C. to sleep
   D. to drink

20. Which German word means "in front of"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. zwischen
   B. in
   C. vor
   D. auf

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the German words with their articles for: rice, milk, egg, banana. (4 marks)

22. Read: "Der Herd ist heiß. Das Messer ist scharf." Explain what the text warns about. (2 marks)

23. Write these numbers in German: 5, 8, 13. (3 marks)

24. Write these numbers in German: 4, 9, 12. (3 marks)

25. Match the body part to what it does: Auge, Ohr, Nase. (3 marks)

26. Explain how your voice should change for a question mark and for a full stop. (2 marks)

27. Spell the name "Zawadi" using German letter names. (3 marks)

28. Write the four punctuation marks with their German names. (4 marks)

29. Name the three umlaut letters and the special letter ß. (2 marks)

30. Write the German words with their articles for: fridge, cooker, plate, spoon. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — like sht
   At the start of a word st sounds like sht.

2. D — thank you
   Danke means thank you.

3. C — die
   It is die Tochter, so the little word is die.

4. C — die
   It is die Schwester, so the little word is die.

5. B — It has four rooms
   hat = has, vier = four, Zimmer = rooms.

6. A — das
   It is das Bett, so the little word is das.

7. C — One more time!
   Noch einmal means once more.

8. A — der Doppelpunkt (:)
   The colon announces a list or speech.

9. D — zehn
   10 in German is zehn.

10. C — Oktober
   After September comes Oktober.

11. B — das
   It is das Mittagessen, so the little word is das.

12. C — tomato
   die Tomate means tomato.

13. A — cocoa
   der Kakao means cocoa.

14. A — mango
   die Mango means mango.

15. D — brown eyes
   braun = brown and Augen = eyes.

16. D — face
   das Gesicht means face.

17. A — cloud
   die Wolke means cloud.

18. B — rainy season
   Regen = rain and Zeit = time.

19. B — to help
   helfen means to help.

20. C — vor
   in front of in German is vor.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, die Milch, das Ei, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cooker is hot and the knife is sharp, so we must be careful in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each warning.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: fünf, acht, dreizehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: vier, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Auge = sehen, Ohr = hören, Nase = riechen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: It goes up at a question mark and down at a full stop.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Z (tset), A (ah), W (vay), A (ah), D (day), I (ee).
   Working / marking points: 3 marks if all letter names are correct; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: . der Punkt, , das Komma, ? das Fragezeichen, ! das Ausrufezeichen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark with its name.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: ä, ö, ü and ß (Eszett).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three umlauts and 1 mark for ß.

30. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kühlschrank, der Herd, der Teller, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.
